mission: Hearts Turn Healing and Recovery provides a structured and supportive outpatient program that helps individuals heal from addiction through personal responsibility, spiritual growth, and compassionate community.
vision: To shape a future where those struggling with mental health and addiction can transform their pain instead of hiding it.

values.title: Integrity
values.description: The foundation of life; to always do what you say you will.

values.title: Trust
values.description: Trust yourself, trust others, and trust in the process.

values.title: Freedom
values.description: From our addictions and from the mechanical self.
